All three map onto knobs that are live in x138, or onto tonight's DIS 2.25 node-bonus lever. I checked each against the x138 source (exp85a env cell and code; exp56 verbatim is identical). All three are UPHELD. None leads to a build, a slot or a rule change. One side fact came out: BIOHUB_GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP=2 in every x138-family file is a no-op, because the code clamps it to 1. findings.what: Probe 8 / exp24: GAP_CLOSE_UM 5.0 -> 6.5. OLD VERDICT (RESULTS.md l.29): LB 0.944 vs exp06 0.945, '-0.001: noise; gap-closing radius stays 5.0'. The same lab (exp07+pp, hold12) gave gap 8 um 0.9586 vs 5 um 0.9619 and 2 frames 0.9583. No earlier recheck cited it. WHAT CHANGED: (1) x138 is the base. It keeps GAP_CLOSE_UM 5.0 (code default 6.0) and adds GAP_DENSITY_ADAPTIVE 1 and GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP 2. (2) Public-vs-private split and the UP test: the -0.001 read was never UP-tested, so its sign is only weakly known. (3) Runtime headroom does not matter; gap closing is CPU-trivial. CHECKED IN CODE (exp85a ipynb, gap-close block): effective_gap_max = min(GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP, 1), so only 1-frame gaps are closed. The threshold is GAP_CLOSE_UM x (gap+1) = 10 um. The density term moves it by at most +-0.125 um per step (reference 6.5 um, gain 0.04), so +-0.25 um. x138's own sweep offered 'gap45' (4.5 um) and did not pick it. NEW VERDICT: UPHELD, stays closed. Both old instruments give sign <= 0 for a larger radius: LB -0.001, and the lab -0.0033 at 8 um. x138 already adjusts the radius for density, and in dense regions (44b6-like, private-heavy) a wider radius adds wrong joins. It belongs to the closed gap-LAP/sandwich family. SIDE FACT: the env value GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP=2 in every x138-family file is dead code (clamped to 1). 2-3-frame gaps are handled only by GAP2 recovery and gapfill (GAPFILL_MAX_GAP 3).
findings.evidence: experiments/RESULTS.md l.29 (probe 8, id 56071497) and l.6/l.8 (exp07+pp gap sweeps). exp85a ipynb env l.17-23 (GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP 2, GAP_CLOSE_UM 5.0, DENSITY ref 6.5 / gain 0.040 / max delta 0.125). Code l.268-270 defaults. Gap-close loop 'effective_gap_max = min(GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP, 1)' and 'threshold_um = GAP_CLOSE_UM * (gap + 1)' (extracted source at scratchpad exp85a_src.py l.3445-3500). PP_CANDIDATES 'gap45' l.5707. exp56 x138 verbatim has the same env.
findings.action: No build, slot or rule change. Curator: add the note 'GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP env 2 is a no-op (clamped to 1) in x138' to the gap-close/gap-LAP entries, so that nobody proposes a max-gap rung later. A 2-3-frame gap idea must target GAP2_* or GAPFILL_*.

findings.what: MOTION_RELINK_TIGHT_UM 5.5 ('tight55'), which every x138-family file carries. OLD CONCLUSION (RESULTS probe 14, CONTEXT l.287/l.461): sjlee101's validator sweep chose tight55 on in-sample train stems (proxy 0.9490 -> 0.9511, +0.002). It became part of the 'realised config', and x138 hard-codes it as 'ppsweep_selected.json of the public run'. No recheck ever cited it. WHAT CHANGED: (1) The imissher 743222 point: in-notebook sweeps score in-sample train stems, and our pool files freeze the pick with VALIDATOR_ENABLE 0 (R33-RC-C). (2) Private means other embryos, so a +0.002 in-sample proxy pick has no private evidence. (3) On x138, flow relink runs in mode 'seed' with FLOW_SEED_GATE_UM 0. CHECKED IN CODE: seed_gate_um = MOTION_RELINK_TIGHT_UM, so 5.5 um is the gate for the confident seed matches that build the per-frame flow field. It is also the tight pass when no field exists. Once a field exists, assignment uses FLOW_TIGHT 7.0 and relaxed 10.0. So the knob is live, but it acts only through the quality of the seed field. NEW VERDICT: UPHELD as the default; not a candidate. No LB read ever isolated it (probes 21-23 changed other relink parts: -0.002 each). The x138 block (~330 teams) and all 10 of our pool files share it, so it cannot move our rank relative to that block. A 0.5 um seed-gate change has no lab on x138 (the exp60 replay cannot run flow relink). Pure public-fit knob class.

findings.what: B25 learned peak pruning: a LOO logistic pruner on raw-graph features drops the lowest-scored X% of raw nodes before post-processing. It aimed at the node-count bonus. OLD VERDICT (RESULTS l.92, l.100): on 4 videos 10% gave +0.0041 (5% -0.0008, 13% -0.0024, 20% -0.0147). On all 12 LOEO-44b6 videos every fraction was negative: 5/8/10/12/13% = -0.0023/-0.0036/-0.0020/-0.0062/-0.0078. Recall after post-processing at 10% was 0.9826, below the 0.99 gate. No recheck cited it. The node-drop family (I-147/I-148) was closed separately in R12. WHAT CHANGED: (1) The only live node-bonus lever, ILP_DISAPPEARANCE_WEIGHT 2.25, gets its first LB reads today: exp89r (~09:25Z) and the DIS code derived per R26-A2. (2) On the dummy-clip GT lab, exp89q vs exp89p has identical TP/FP/FN and gains +0.0004 from the node bonus alone (R26-RC-A). That shows the bonus channel works mechanically on x138. (3) Private is other embryos; 44b6-like density is where B25 lost most. NEW VERDICT: UPHELD. Pre-registered before any DIS read: a DIS '+' does NOT reopen B25. DIS removes nodes through an ILP topology cost, so the removed nodes are short-lived ones. B25 removes them by a learned peak score, and its honest 12-video test, which already included the bonus, lost at every fraction because recall losses dominate. A DIS '-' or '0' only strengthens the closure. B25 also has no code in x138 and would be new code after R8.
